statements.subject: session
statements.description: All errors detected while processing the OPEN message MUST be indicated by sending the NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code OPEN Message Error.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the version number in the Version field of the received OPEN message is not supported, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unsupported Version Number.
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Unsupported Version Number, Data=largest_locally_supported_version)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the Autonomous System field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad Peer AS.
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Bad Peer AS)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the Hold Time field of the OPEN message is unacceptable, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unacceptable Hold Time. An implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds.
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Unacceptable Hold Time)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the BGP Identifier field of the OPEN message is syntactically incorrect, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad BGP Identifier.
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Bad BGP Identifier)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is not recognized, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unsupported Optional Parameters.
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Unsupported Optional Parameters)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If one of the Optional Parameters in the OPEN message is recognized, but is malformed, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to 0 (Unspecific).
actions: send NOTIFICATION(Error Code=OPEN Message Error, Subcode=Unspecific)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: An implementation that accepts a Hold Time MUST use the negotiated value for the Hold Time.
